key: We have drunk Soma and become immortal; we have attained the light, the Gods discovered.
s: In a hymn on Soma at work within the drinker’s heart and limbs, the singers speak after the draught goes down; Sāyaṇa, on 8.48.3, takes the deathlessness as hoped for from drinking one who is himself deathless, and the light as shining heaven.

evidence.words: हे अमृत अमरण सोम त्वाम् "अपाम पानं करवाम। कुर्मः। ततः "अमृताः "अभूम भवेम । यस्मात्त्वममृतः अतस्तव पानाद्वयमप्यमृताः स्याम । पश्चात् "ज्योतिः द्योतमानं स्वर्गम्
evidence.gloss: O immortal, deathless Soma, we drink you (apāma glossed as making the drink); then may we become immortal (abhūma glossed bhavema). Since you are immortal, by drinking you we too would be immortal. Afterwards we went to the light, the shining heaven.
